footer.titleHtml:
Get funded, connected,
and scale across LatAm & China
footer.bottomNote: Built for founders, investors, and corporate innovators bridging Latin America and China.

meta.title: Challenges & Competitions | LATAM China Tech
meta.description: Explore startup competitions, corporate challenges, and innovation opportunities connecting Latin America and China.

featured.title: Greater Tech Challenge 2025
featured.description: The flagship innovation competition bridging Latin America and China. Submit your breakthrough solution in AI, cleantech, or biotech and compete for the largest prize pool in the region.

cards.name: China-LATAM FinTech Cup
cards.description: Financial inclusion innovation across emerging markets. Build solutions for the unbanked across Brazil, Mexico, and Southeast China.

cards.name: Food Future Challenge
cards.description: Transforming agriculture supply chains between Latin America's farmlands and China's markets using AI, IoT, and precision agriculture.

cards.name: Clean Energy Sprint
cards.description: Accelerating decarbonization across Latin American cities using Chinese clean energy technology. Solar, wind, and grid innovation welcome.

cards.name: AI Founders Battle
cards.description: Early-stage AI founders competing for market access, seed investment, and a 6-month acceleration in Shenzhen and São Paulo.

cards.name: Trade Route 2050 Challenge
cards.description: Reimagining cross-Pacific logistics for the next generation with autonomous freight, port automation, and smart customs solutions.

cards.name: EduBridge Hackathon
cards.description: A 48-hour sprint for multilingual education tools serving underserved communities through Chinese EdTech infrastructure.

cards.name: Pacific BioVenture Prize
cards.description: Connecting biotech startups with LATAM-China co-development pathways. The 2024 edition closed and 2026 early access is now open.

cards.name: Smart Factory Sprint
cards.description: Industry 4.0 solutions for LATAM manufacturing powered by Chinese automation and IoT technology. Hardware and software welcome.

featured.title: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025
featured.description: The premier programme for established LATAM companies ready to enter the Chinese market through structured support, in-market immersion, and direct access to distribution partners.

cards.name: SME Export Accelerator
cards.description: For established companies seeking to scale their China market strategy with structured advisory, trade facilitation, and on-ground support.

cards.name: MedBridge Innovation Award
cards.description: Connecting Latin American biotech companies with China's healthcare distribution and co-development market through an enterprise track.

cards.name: LATAM Brands in China
cards.description: A corporate challenge for LATAM consumer brands preparing to launch on China's e-commerce platforms with Tier-1 distribution partners.

cards.name: Green Infrastructure Challenge
cards.description: Corporate track for infrastructure teams partnering with Chinese EPC firms on LATAM renewable energy projects.

cards.name: Cross-Border Finance Forum
cards.description: A challenge for banks, fintechs, and payments companies building LATAM-China FX infrastructure and payment corridors.

tabs.label: Academic Innovation
tabs.emptyStateBody: Programmes for universities, research institutes, and academic entrepreneurs are coming soon.

meta.description: Submit a competition registration with LATAM China Tech guidance and application support.

preRegistrationPage.subtitle: Ready to apply? Fill in the form below and our team personally guides you through every step of your application.
preRegistrationPage.selectedSubtitleTemplate: Ready to apply? Fill in the form below and our team personally guides you through every step of your application.

pre-registration.selectedSubtitleTemplate: Ready to apply? Fill in the form below and our team personally guides you through every step of your application.

registration.selectedSubtitleTemplate: Ready to apply? Fill in the form below and our team personally guides you through every step of your application.

banner.title: Register now
banner.descriptionHtml: Submit this form and LATAM CHINA TECH will personally guide you through your full application: reviewing your submission, strengthening your pitch, and maximizing your chances of winning.

guide.title: Application Guide & Tutorial
guide.description: If you need support, download our step-by-step PDF guide. It covers competition rules, timeline, and tips for a winning application. It's available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

sections.competitionInformationSubtitle: Choose the competition and share the core details about your project and company.
sections.applicantSubtitle: Personal details of the lead applicant.
sections.projectSubtitle: Tell us about your startup - if you need, you can also use AI as a tool to help you write each section faster
sections.beijingSubtitle: Tell us how this opportunity fits your market-entry or growth strategy.

notes.applicant: Instructions: The main applicant must be the company's largest shareholder, with 30% or more equity.
notes.beijing: Important: Describe the strategic fit for this competition clearly, including any market-entry, partnership, or geographic expansion plans.

fields.selectedCompetitionPlaceholder: Select the competition you are applying to
fields.projectIntroductionPlaceholder: Describe your project in 30-50 words. What problem does it solve? Who does it serve?
fields.companyHeadquarters: Is your company a legally registered entity?
fields.emailPlaceholder: your@companyemail.com - Enter a valid email address to receive confirmations and updates.
fields.elevatorPitchPlaceholder: Add a compelling one-sentence pitch for your startup
fields.projectOverviewPlaceholder: Provide a detailed overview of your project — the problem it addresses, your solution approach, and why now.
fields.productFeaturesPlaceholder: Describe the key features and differentiators of your product or service.
fields.businessModelPlaceholder: Explain how your startup generates revenue and your go-to-market strategy.
fields.teamIntroductionPlaceholder: Introduce your founding team — backgrounds, expertise, and why you're the right team to execute this vision.
fields.investmentValuePlaceholder: Describe what your company has achieved so far, such as product progress, users, specific revenue, and key milestones.
fields.fundingAmountRequestedPlaceholder: Tell us the funding amount you are requesting and how the capital would be used.
fields.pitchingDeckUploadLabel: Click to upload your Pitch Deck
fields.supplementaryMaterialsUploadSubtext: Any format — videos, demos, reports, patents
fields.expectedBenefits: What do you expect to receive?
fields.hearAbout: Where did you hear about us?
fields.beijingPlanPlaceholder: Describe why this competition is the right fit. Include your expansion plan, target market, partnership strategy, or the cross-border opportunity you want to unlock.
fields.incorporationTimelineHint: Use this to tell us when you expect to activate the next step after selection.
fields.incorporationTimelinePlaceholder: When do you plan to move forward?

aiAssistance.disabledLabel: Upload a pitch deck to use AI Assistance
aiAssistance.disclosure: By using AI Assistance, you agree that LATAM CHINA TECH may process your pitch deck and current form inputs through third-party AI providers to generate draft application text. AI output may be incomplete or inaccurate. Please review and edit all fields before submitting, and only upload materials you are authorized to share.
aiAssistance.successMessage: AI draft added. Please review every field before submitting.
aiAssistance.errorMessage: AI Assistance could not analyze this file. You can continue filling the form manually.
aiAssistance.overwritePrompt: AI found suggestions for fields you already filled. Replace existing text with the AI draft?
aiAssistance.unsupportedFileMessage: AI Assistance supports PDF and PPTX decks. You can still submit this file manually.

submission.successMessage: Application submitted. Our team will contact you with next steps.
submission.errorMessage: We could not submit the form. Please try again.
submission.validationMessage: Please complete the required fields and upload a pitch deck (or paste a deck link) before submitting.

saveDraft.hint: Drafts are saved in this browser only (files aren't saved).

preRegistrationPage.deckLinkHint: Deck over 20MB? Paste a Google Drive / Dropbox link instead.
companyHeadquartersOptions: Not yet established as a company
preRegistrationPage.submitNoteHtml: By submitting, you confirm that the information is accurate and agree to be contacted by LATAM CHINA TECH for competition-specific follow-up and application support.
